Container.Name: RipAudit
Container.Overview:
[DEVELOPMENT BUILD - not yet published] RipAudit checks newly ripped movie files for runtime discrepancies. It measures each file with FFprobe, uses Plex's identification to fetch an independent runtime from TMDB, and lists possible incomplete rips, edition mismatches, and unmatched files for review. It complements Tdarr's decode health checks and never modifies your media. A matching runtime is not proof that a rip is complete.
External services: RipAudit contacts your Plex server and the TMDB API (api.themoviedb.org) using credentials you provide, and optionally your ntfy or webhook endpoint. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. RipAudit is not affiliated with Plex, Tdarr, DVDFab, or Unraid.
First run: open the WebUI and enter the setup token from appdata/ripaudit/setup-token to create your account.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: rip audit runtime bluray dvdfab plex tmdb tdarr incomplete
Container.Requires: Plex Media Server with your movie libraries, and a free TMDB API Read Access Token. Media must be mounted read-only.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the RipAudit web interface. Keep it on your LAN or behind a TLS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, settings, session key, and first-run setup token. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Movies (read-only)
Config.Description: Your movie library, mounted read-only. In RipAudit Settings, map Plex's path for this library to /media/Movies.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for timestamps and the daily digest hour.

Config.Name: Media roots
Config.Description: Comma-separated container paths to watch on first start. Can be changed later in Settings.

Config.Name: Plex token (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Supply the Plex token here instead of in the WebUI. Environment values override WebUI values and are never written to appdata.

Config.Name: TMDB credential (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. TMDB API Read Access Token (preferred) or v3 API key.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR. Secrets are redacted from logs.
